placeUrls.title: Google Maps place URLs
placeUrls.description: Google Maps URLs to scrape. Open a place in Google Maps and copy the URL from the address bar. Short links (maps.app.goo.gl) are followed automatically. NOTE: a free-text search query is NOT accepted here - Google no longer exposes place search to non-browser clients, so this actor works from place identifiers only.

placeIds.title: Place IDs / CIDs / feature IDs
placeIds.description: Alternative to URLs. Accepts a Place ID (ChIJ...), a numeric CID, or a raw feature ID (0x...:0x...). One per line.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: reviews = every review plus a per-place summary row (default). summary_only = one page of reviews, emit only the aggregated sentiment summary (fast and cheap). owner_responses = only reviews the business replied to, for response-rate analysis.

maxReviewsPerPlace.title: Max reviews per place
maxReviewsPerPlace.description: Stop after this many reviews per place. Google serves up to 60 on the first page and 20 per page after that.

sortBy.title: Sort reviews by
sortBy.description: Google applies this server-side. 'relevant' returns a mixed-rating sample; 'newest' is the only order that reliably walks the whole list.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Keep only reviews rated at or above this value (1-5).

maxRating.title: Maximum rating
maxRating.description: Keep only reviews rated at or below this value (1-5). Combine with the minimum to isolate, say, 1-2 star complaints.

onlyWithOwnerResponse.title: Only reviews with an owner response
onlyWithOwnerResponse.description: Keep only reviews the business has replied to.

boundingBox.title: Bounding box [south, west, north, east]
boundingBox.description: Keep only places inside this box. Requires the input URL to carry coordinates (the !3d/!4d or @lat,lng part of a Maps URL) - see the README on geographic filtering.

centerLatitude.title: Radius filter - centre latitude
centerLatitude.description: Latitude of the centre point, used with centre longitude and radius.

radiusKm.title: Radius filter - radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Keep only places within this many kilometres of the centre point.

areaName.title: Named area
areaName.description: Shorthand for a built-in bounding box, e.g. 'jakarta', 'bali', 'london', 'indonesia'. For anywhere else use an explicit bounding box.

onMissingCoordinates.title: When a place has no coordinates
onMissingCoordinates.description: How to treat a place whose input URL carries no coordinates while a geographic filter is active. 'keep' scrapes it anyway and logs a warning; 'skip' emits a SKIPPED record instead.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the run's records to the key-value store in these formats. The Apify dataset is always produced regardless.

language.title: Language (hl)
language.description: Google interface language. Also decides which language Google translates reviews into.

region.title: Region (gl)
region.description: Two-letter country code biasing Google's response, e.g. US, ID, GB.

pageSize.title: First-page size
pageSize.description: Reviews requested on the first page. Google caps this at 60 and always returns 20 per page afterwards.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default, and that is the recommended setting. These endpoints have no WAF, so the platform's own IP works fine and costs nothing. Enable a proxy only to spread load across IPs at high volume, and leave the group list empty so Apify picks a group your plan has. RESIDENTIAL is NOT recommended here: Google polices residential proxy pools heavily and answers them with a consent or CAPTCHA interstitial, which makes places fail to resolve.
